criteria.text: Same canonical input produces the same maximum-cardinality safe wave and receipt.

evidence.name: PDP01 selects the largest safe ready set across design, implementation, test, and review packages
PDP03 finds a maximum safe wave instead of using a greedy first-ready selection
SLC03 binds the exact maximum-cardinality frozen receipt and preserves every blocked reason

criteria.note: Demonstrated as a synthetic in-process contract only (ADR-0044); no candidate-bound integration against authoritative paths/resources is exercised here, per the matrix's own 'Remaining gap' cell for #12.

criteria.text: Cycles, unknown dependencies/write sets, overlapping authority and stale receipts fail closed.

evidence.name: PDP10 fails closed for unknown dependencies, cycles, and malformed package contracts
PDP02 serializes overlapping write paths with a stable reason and lexicographic tie-break
SLC04 rejects unknown dependency/write/resource sets, overlapping authority and mixed candidates before planner admission
SLC06 rejects handwritten/stale receipts, package-set drift and non-canonical package input

criteria.text: Every unselected ready package has an explicit dependency, path, resource or capacity reason.

evidence.name: PDP05 uses a capacity reason only after every conflict-free slot is filled
PDP06 permits every slot to be reserved and explains the resulting serialization
PDP07 reports unused capacity when conflicts, rather than arbitrary serialization, prevent another dispatch
PDP09 validates a caller-held receipt and rejects an omitted ready-package explanation

criteria.text: Completion, failure, cancellation and invalidation yield a deterministic next-wave plan with separate package evidence.

evidence.name: SLC07 imports only independently selected verified outcomes and binds revision/previous digest
SLC08 propagates failure, cancellation and invalidation transitively to the original terminal root
SLC09 rejects replayed terminal evidence and duplicate/out-of-order terminal observations
SLC05 scopes attempt identity to each dispatch while retaining global dispatch uniqueness

criteria.text: Request, admission, state, heartbeat, cancellation, timeout, result and evidence envelopes are closed and versioned.

evidence.name: EPC01 publishes exact Draft 2020-12 roots and closes every nested subject/request shape
EPC03 keeps request Schema and runtime admission parallel and excludes raw provider/private fields
EPC07 keeps the closed full TimedObservation state envelope parallel with runtime admission

criteria.text: Locality, workspace, network, mounts, resource limits, sidecars and write capability are explicit.

evidence.name: EPC04 binds paths, resource units, locality, network and timing without a capability false success

criteria.text: Advertised capacity and observed admission remain separate.

evidence.name: EPC02 keeps execution-subject Schema and runtime admission parallel over the closed corpus
EPC08 normalizes success as unverified and reserves verified for matching verifier evidence

criteria.text: Synthetic adapters cover success, failure, timeout, cancellation, retry, duplicate delivery and lost heartbeat.

evidence.name: EPC10 covers duplicate, out-of-order, stale candidate, failure, timeout, cancellation, lost heartbeat and completed-undelivered without false success

criteria.note: Coverage is against the synthetic in-process adapter fixture (ADR-0044) only, not a production executor; the matrix's #14 'Remaining gap' cell already says production executor adapter coverage remains separately approved.

criteria.text: The frozen control/execution exchange remains unchanged.

evidence.name: EPC06 builds a frozen canonical request and detects post-construction digest drift
EPC09 rejects unbound and forged chains, admitting successors only with a complete genesis history
EPC05 rejects stale, replayed, candidate-drifted and frozen-binding-drifted admission contexts
